changes.content:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps/api
      - run: npm ci && npm test
        working-directory: apps/api
  web:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Build web image
        id: shearbolt-build
        run: |
          docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/acme/web:${{ github.sha }} -t ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} apps/web
          echo shearbolt-image=ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        env:
          SHEARBOLT_IMAGE: ${{ steps.shearbolt-build.outputs.shearbolt-image }}
        with:
          working-directory: apps/web
      - name: Push web image
        run: docker push ghcr.io/acme/web:${{ github.sha }}
  cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: crates/cli
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Install cargo-auditable
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-auditable
      - run: cargo auditable build --release --locked
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        with:
          working-directory: crates/cli

# Shearbolt's daily run of ci.yml: its build and its scan, without the steps after the scan.
# `shearbolt setup` writes this file. Run it again after you change ci.yml.
name: Shearbolt daily (ci)
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 4 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps/api
  web:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Build web image
        id: shearbolt-build
        run: |
          docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/acme/web:${{ github.sha }} -t ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} apps/web
          echo shearbolt-image=ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        env:
          SHEARBOLT_IMAGE: ${{ steps.shearbolt-build.outputs.shearbolt-image }}
        with:
          working-directory: apps/web
  cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: crates/cli
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Install cargo-auditable
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-auditable
      - run: cargo auditable build --release --locked
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        with:
          working-directory: crates/cli

notes.message: No build step was found for apps/api, so the gate in ci.yml: test checks its lockfiles.

setup adds the local tag ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} to the gated image builds and the gate scans it; it is never pushed, so a scan that falls back to the registry fails instead of reading an older image

runs the build and the scan of ci.yml once a day (04:23 UTC) on the default branch, without the steps after the scan; it runs once this file is on the default branch. GitHub turns scheduled workflows off in a public repository after 60 days without activity (Actions → the workflow → Enable workflow turns it on again).
